name: SPECIMEN_CYCLES
description: The fertility treatment cycles that are associated with oocyte, embryo, or sperm specimens. For example, an embryo can be linked to an egg retrieval/freeze cycle and also a thaw/embryo transfer cycle.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the specimen record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CYCLE_ID
columns.description: The fertility treatment cycles that are associated with the fertility specimen. This includes the cycle that the oocyte or embryo was retrieved on, transferred, frozen, or thawed.
